selection: second round after a failed first round

neighbours.label: Light hair and complexion as a person's trait (fair-haired, blonde, blond, freckled and ruddy); other hair and body words stay quiet
fire: Her fair-haired nephew has very light lashes.
A blonde woman in a green coat waved at us.
The twins were both blond and tall for their age.
His ruddy, freckled face turned red in the sun.
The painter loved her fair-haired, rosy-cheeked models.
She wore her blonde curls in a loose braid.
That boy with the blond fringe is my cousin.
A freckled, red-haired girl sat by the door.
quiet: Her dark-haired nephew has very long lashes.
A tall woman in a green coat waved at us.
The twins were both thin and quick for their age.
His sharp, narrow face turned away in the crowd.
The painter loved her curly-haired, sad-eyed models.
She wore her long curls in a loose braid.
That boy with the short fringe is my cousin.
A bored, sleepy girl sat by the door.

notes: Second round. Round 1 failed partly on 'white settlers' (0.11) and 'a fair bride' (0.01), so white as a group label and 'fair' alone are dropped. 'pale skin' probed 0.09, so it is left out too.
